name: Mitshu Non-Stick Frying Pan with Spatula
description: Durable non-stick frying pan with a heat-resistant exterior and ergonomic Bakelite handle. Comes with a matching slotted spatula for effortless everyday cooking.
details: This Mitshu non-stick frying pan is designed for convenient, everyday cooking in Sri Lankan kitchens. The interior features a smooth non-stick coating that prevents food from sticking and makes cleaning effortless. Its heat-resistant outer coating adds extra durability and scratch resistance. Equipped with a comfortable, stay-cool Bakelite handle and a matching slotted turner spatula, it is ideal for frying eggs, meats, and vegetables with minimal oil.
